findings.title: Hardcoded live payment API key in source
SQL injection: user-supplied email interpolated into query via f-string
findings.evidence: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = '{email}'"

findings.title: Mutable default argument; the shared list is passed as invoice.items and appended to, so line items accumulate across calls
N+1 queries: one order_items query per order inside a loop
Charge request sent without an idempotency key; retries or concurrent runs can double-charge the customer
Broad except Exception: pass swallows all failures (network, HTTP, missing charge_id) with no logging and an implicit None return
Leftover debug print writes the full invoice to stdout instead of using the logger
Path traversal: unvalidated query parameter joined to EXPORT_DIR (../ or absolute path escapes the directory); use send_from_directory or safe_join
File opened without explicit encoding; output depends on platform locale
